scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run python -m foray.env && uv run uvicorn foray.asgi:application --reload --reload-dir foray --reload-dir apps --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 5
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run python -m foray.env && uv run watchfiles --filter python --sigint-timeout 15 "python manage.py worker --shutdown-timeout 5" foray apps
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,yellow,magenta "pnpm dev" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.dev:session: cd backend && uv run python manage.py dev_session
scripts.lint: eslint && cd backend && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && cd backend && uv run pyright
scripts.api:types: cd backend && uv run python manage.py export_openapi_schema --api foray.api.api --output openapi.json --indent 2 && cd .. && openapi-typescript backend/openapi.json -o src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm api:types && git diff --exit-code backend/openapi.json src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.db:create: docker compose exec -T db sh -c "psql -U foray -d postgres -tc \"select 1 from pg_database where datname='foray_app'\" | grep -q 1 || createdb -U foray foray_app"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run python manage.py migrate
scripts.db:makemigrations: cd backend && uv run python manage.py makemigrations
scripts.db:backup-legacy: cd backend && uv run python manage.py backup_legacy
scripts.db:import-legacy: cd backend && uv run python manage.py import_legacy
scripts.db:verify-import: cd backend && uv run python manage.py verify_import
scripts.auth:set-password: cd backend && uv run python manage.py set_password
scripts.seed:companies: cd backend && uv run python manage.py seed_companies
scripts.fetch:board: cd backend && uv run python manage.py fetch_board
scripts.verify:boards: cd backend && uv run python manage.py verify_boards
scripts.llm:smoke: cd backend && uv run python manage.py llm_smoke
scripts.llm:bakeoff: cd backend && uv run python manage.py llm_bakeoff
